request.input:
1girl, 1boy, adult standing man and adult seated woman, close landscape composition. Similar head sizes; figures fill canvas, cropped below knees.

Man stands on the floor behind woman at screen-left, both legs straight, hips above her seat. He leans forward, face frontal, eyes staring directly at viewer. Woman sits sideways on carved wooden chair foreground right, turns face toward viewer, hands on closed gilded book in lap. His right hand grips coffee cup at chest, left hand supports saucer. Two small books float behind her.

Narrow cold sidelight from left, dark upper background, illuminated lower skirt. Half his face and torso merge into solid black shadow; lit skin stays deep brown. Dark paneled wall, muted jade and ivory, intimidating stillness.

0.9::quasarcake::, 0.5::rella::, 0.4::gomzi::, 0.3::piromizu::

arknights, game promotional illustration, painterly anime illustration. Complete, clean silhouettes and carefully resolved facial features and hands. Use clear grouped shadows and angular cloth folds. Keep fine linework selective around the eyes, fingers and accessories. Skin has delicate restrained transitions. Alternate crisp focal edges with softer background edges while keeping contours complete. Rich but controlled color, precise focal detail, quieter background detail.

masterpiece, best quality, very aesthetic, masterpiece, no text, rating:general
